thread:
lee: New hire hit a blocker in the JS starter repo when using function calls + json_mode strict. Python example fine.

olga: Can you paste the error and the request payload?

lee: Error: SchemaValidatorError: expected object but got string. Payload observed: '{\"account_id\":\"a1\",\"profile\":\"\"}'

riley: That looks like an empty field turned into an empty string during a retry. We've seen the stream retry wrapper coerce non-text chunks.

lee: Repro steps: npm i @redwood/sdk-js; run examples/starter-js; trigger upsert_account flow. Happens intermittently when network jitter causes a client retry.

olga: Quick unblock for onboarding?

riley: Short term: set json_mode: 'lenient' in the example or make the function schema accept profile: {"type":"object","default":{}}. Also you can export RW_SDK_DISABLE_CLIENT_RETRY=true to bypass transient string injection.

lee: I'll update the starter README with the env workaround and the lenient note. Good enough for new hires.

riley: I'll open a fix in the JS SDK to change the stream helper: buffer typed chunks and attempt to reparse merged payloads instead of appending raw strings. Add unit tests that simulate streaming+retry.

olga: Please add a visible warning log when the SDK detects text inserted into a JSON-mode response so users get actionable guidance instead of a silent validation fail.

riley: Will do. PR: devex/js-sdk#472. Adding integration test in starter-kit CI that runs the fn-call example with json_mode=strict.

qa-bot: CI job created: starter-kit-integration/strict-json -> queued.

lee: Thanks team. Once PR merges I'll run through onboarding with new hires to confirm.

devex-bot: Task created: devex/js-sdk#472 -> staging.

olga: Nice - thanks. :thumbsup:
